statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail risk stays in the low band after a failed overnight probe toward the record high met a normal retracement, while Stress stays high on a 24-year-high long-end yield backdrop.
recommendation: Tail remains below the watch threshold on contained, two-sided overnight NQ structure. The identified danger window spans 12:15Z to 15:30Z, covering the ADP report at 12:15Z, the August PCE release and Q2 GDP third estimate together at 12:30Z, the 13:30Z US cash open and the 13:45Z Chicago PMI. A secondary flow concentration sits at the 20:00Z quarter-end closing auction and the Micron fiscal Q4 release that follows the close.
headline: Failed overnight probe toward the record high retraces normally, keeping Tail low; 24-year-high long yields keep Stress high into the quarter-end PCE and GDP cluster
body:
NQ futures trade near 30,598-30,609, essentially unchanged on the session, inside a contained overnight band of about 30,571-30,737. Price opened near 30,657, extended to 30,737 within roughly 34 points of the 30,770.63 52-week high, and has since retraced about 130 points, or 0.4%, back into the lower half of that 0.54%-wide band. That is a failed upside probe followed by a normal retracement, which is the opposite of the shallow-or-absent pullback signature that defines a pathological path. There is no observed repeated extension after failed retracements and NQ is not holding a session extreme. The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed September 29 at 30,339.33, up 0.21%, after a narrow 30,235.67-30,429.97 range. E-mini S&P 500 futures are firmer near 7,747, about 0.19% higher, so the two US index futures are not aligned in one direction. VIX sits near 16.04, marginally lower. Asian trade was firm but dispersed: the Nikkei 225 gained 1.81% to 66,770 with the Topix up 1.58%, while the Hang Seng finished flat near 24,466. On this evidence Tail stays in the low band at 16 and the mapped policy state is EA_ON.

The Stress backdrop remains genuinely difficult and is the reason Stress holds 65 in the high band. The 30-year Treasury yield reached 5.61-5.62% on September 29, its highest since 2002 and a sixth consecutive daily advance, with the 10-year near 5.28-5.29% and the 2-year at 4.92%. Reporting attributes the move to elevated oil feeding inflation expectations, a possible yen carry unwind and roughly 70% priced odds of a further Fed increase at the October 28 meeting, after the September hike. Critically, that long-end repricing has not transmitted into one-way equity downside: the Nasdaq-100 still closed higher on the day the 24-year yield high printed, so the yield backdrop is scored as Stress rather than Tail. Oil is easing from stressed levels, with Brent near $95.89-96 and WTI near $89-91 as Saudi pipeline capacity is restored, Middle East exports recover toward pre-war volumes, US-Iran talks resume and a strategic reserve release is planned. That reduces, rather than adds to, the geopolitical amplifier. Q3 leaves extreme regional dispersion behind it, with the KOSPI down about 19% and the Shanghai Composite down 6.19% against a 6.93% Hang Seng gain, which is a difficult environment rather than a current NQ path risk.

The horizon is dominated by one dense catalyst cluster on the final session of Q3. The ADP September report lands at 12:15Z, then the August PCE price index and the Q2 GDP third estimate print together at 12:30Z, with the September Chicago PMI at 13:45Z straddling the 13:30Z cash open. Consensus looks for core PCE near +0.3% month-on-month and about 3.3% annually, and the BEA publishes its annual national accounts update alongside the release, so recent inflation history may be restated. That revision layer adds interpretation noise and supports the conditional watch band across 12:00Z to 15:00Z without implying a direction. A secondary concentration sits at the 20:00Z quarter-end closing auction and the Micron fiscal Q4 release that follows the close, with its call at 20:30Z against guidance near $50 billion of revenue and about $31 in adjusted earnings; a semiconductor repricing in thin post-close liquidity is the most credible overnight gap mechanism. The leaked Anthropic IPO prospectus reported on September 29 keeps valuation scrutiny on the AI trade elevated but has produced no observed index-level one-way structure. The shared Finviz context was collected at 2026-09-29T23:14:22Z, is therefore several hours beyond the 90-minute freshness threshold, and reported partial coverage with its futures and calendar sections unavailable, so it carries no weight in this assessment beyond confirming the dispersed latest-session megacap tone. No forecast slot reaches the block threshold on current evidence. The named invalidation is a post-release path that produces shallow or absent pullbacks, repeated extension after failed retracements, or NQ holding a session extreme, in which case Tail would be reassessed upward on observed structure.

lookbackSummary: Across the 24 hours to 05:00Z, published Claude assessments eased steadily from Tail 20 with Stress 78 early on September 29 to Tail 16 with Stress 65 across the final six slots. The September 29 US session produced a narrow Nasdaq-100 range and a modestly higher close even as the 30-year yield reached a 24-year high, and dominant mode migrated through trend-up and trend-down into normal and then mixed as two-sided behaviour reasserted itself overnight. One hour, 14:00Z on September 29, has no published assessment and remains explicitly unavailable.
outlookSummary: The horizon is shaped by one dense catalyst cluster on the final session of Q3. Conditional Tail stays in the low band through the Asian and European hours, enters the watch band across 12:00Z to 15:00Z as the ADP report, the August PCE release with BEA annual revisions, the Q2 GDP third estimate, the US cash open and the Chicago PMI overlap, then decays through the US afternoon. A second watch-band lift spans 20:00Z to 21:00Z for the quarter-end closing auction and the post-close Micron fiscal Q4 release before conditional Tail reaches its horizon low of 15 late in the Asian session. Stress follows the same arc and crosses from high into elevated only in the final two slots. No slot reaches the block threshold on current evidence. The named invalidation is a post-release path with shallow or absent pullbacks, repeated extension after failed retracements, or NQ holding a session extreme.
